text:
Use with caution / monitor.

Administration of amiodarone with digoxin results in an increase in serum digoxin concentrations, increasing digoxin levels by approximately 70% [amiodarone:drug_interactions:9, digoxin:drug_interactions:1]. This interaction occurs because amiodarone inhibits p-glycoprotein [amiodarone:drug_interactions:0], which is a transporter involved in the excretion and absorption of digoxin [digoxin:drug_interactions:1]. Consequently, it is recommended to reduce the digoxin dose and closely monitor serum levels [amiodarone:drug_interactions:4, digoxin:drug_interactions:1].
